purpose: Read-only source inventory for a separately versioned acquisition-disjoint lunar benchmark; this file contains no model performance or tuning decisions.
proposed_assignment_policy: Connected components of positive absolute interval overlap on trace ID OR equal raw sample hash/shape/dtype/rate. Entire component goes to test if any historical member was test, else val if any was val, else train. Previously unresolved local event defaults to train. Exact waveform spans consolidate; distinct partial spans stay separate in one split. No model outcomes used.
time_policy: Catalog absolute UTC is authoritative; relative picks are derived from each actual raw start. Original catalog relative values are retained as provenance, not reused for shifted-start files.
